name: projection-delta-atomic
body: The mutation computes the exact node/edge delta it writes and applies that same delta to the projection deterministically, inside the same logical mutation/commit boundary as the durable/transient write. A re-ingest failure rolls the projection back and the mutation reports failure; a success leaves the projection equal to the new sources. Acceptance: add-then-remove and remove-then-add of the same node both converge to the correct projection without a scan; a forced mid-apply failure leaves the prior projection state intact.
